justification: Calibration Lane 3 (climate). Dispatched at critical tier because the subject is a served composite score on a paid surface. The measurement found the score is NOT rendered on any customer-facing surface, and the delivered change is consequently documentation plus one new read-only measurement script — no served output, no scoring logic, no DB write, no new gate. Tier retained as dispatched rather than downgraded, because the CONCLUSION (that the composite has never been validated and cannot be with available data) is the load-bearing artefact and must not ship on a weak check.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The script exits non-zero in three distinct ways, each a reportable outcome rather than a pass. REFERENCE AVAILABLE when one extractable table pairs at least ten distinct text labels with parseable numbers on a page naming an ASGS geography. REFERENCE NOT EXTRACTABLE when no such table exists but a document mentioning SA3 or SA4 carries content-sized raster images nothing can read — which is the actual state of this corpus. POSSIBLE SPLIT SERIES when pairs accumulate across tables on geography pages without any single table clearing the bar. It returns 0 only when a table was genuinely looked for, none was found, and no unread raster sits in any geography-bearing document. Demonstrated across ten planted cases, not asserted: nothing planted, a prose-names decoy and a twelve-row insurer table headed 'Regional' all stay ABSENT at exit 0; a twelve-row SA3 annex using off-list names gives AVAILABLE exit 1, including beside an unreadable brochure and when filed in a subdirectory as .PDF; a text-less scan, an embedded raster page in an SA3 document, and a figure-sized raster beside SA3 prose all give RED exit 1. The authority is external — APRA and ICA published PDFs — so the check never compares our claim against our own scoring code.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: APRA Mind the Gap Insurance CVA 2026, APRA Climate Vulnerability Assessment Banking 2021, APRA Climate Risk Self Assessment 2024, ICA Catastrophe Resilience Reports, IPCC AR6 WGII, NSW adaptation and coastal assessments, five council climate strategies — 22 documents, 1303 pages, none authored by us.

pre_impl.existing_data: Four-sweep run before writing anything. DB: property_reports holds shadow 538, flood 151, solar-yield 63, bushfire 60 and NO climate product; zero rows carry a composite band or interaction_bonus; report_audit_trail has zero climate or NARCliM mentions. Frontend: app/climate-risk/, ClimateRiskTool.tsx, ClimateRiskResultCard.tsx, api/satellite/climate-risk/route.ts. Python: climate_risk_score.py, climate_risk_raster.py, climate_risk_pipeline.py, conveyancing.py _fetch_climate, intelligence_brief.py _build_climate_disclosure. Corpus: 22 PDFs under climate_risk_intel/ including a council_strategies/ subdirectory. Plans/memory: ce-calibration-execution-plan-2026-08.md section 4f row 3, INDEX_SATELLITE.md.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The dispatch stated a correlation test was written months ago and never run. That is false and was reported before anything was run. No such test exists: not in tests/, not quarantined in tests/conftest.py collect_ignore, and not in any branch's history (git log --all over apra/correlation/spearman paths returns only the blog page, the marketing stats and the 51 pure-logic unit tests from #303). What exists is a one-line PLAN in docs/CLIMATE_RISK_METHODOLOGY.md under 'Planned V2 improvements'. The second assumption — that the source PDF supplies the reference — is also false: the PDF is on disk but contains no SA3 series.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No existing script reads climate_risk_intel/ (git grep -il climate_risk_intel over *.py returns nothing). data/climate_risk_reference.json is the output of a manual read of those PDFs with no script behind it; this script replaces that unverifiable manual step for the one question it answers. Documented as prior-art-checked in the module docstring.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The external sources here are the 17 PDFs on disk, read via fitz and pdfplumber. A corrupt or text-layerless PDF raises from fitz.open and aborts the sweep rather than scoring the document as empty, so an unreadable file cannot masquerade as a file containing no reference. A missing corpus directory exits 1 as RED. No network source is contacted: APRA publishes no API for this data, which is itself part of the finding. The three APRA PDFs were also cross-read directly to confirm the sweep's negative — SA3 appears twice in prose on page 17 and the regional results are raster images, matching what the script reports.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type changes. The composite's TypeScript surface was read, not edited: ClimateRiskResultCard.tsx declares score as number and band as string on its ClimateRiskOutputs interface and renders neither, so the fields are structurally present and visually absent. That mismatch is reported in residual_risk rather than corrected, because narrowing the interface would be a served-contract change and D3 did not trigger.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If this job had manufactured a correlation instead of stopping, the user-visible failure would be a composite score described as validated against APRA when it had been compared to a construct measuring something else — insurance affordability rather than hazard exposure — at a sample size where the pass mark cannot discriminate. Nobody would see an error; they would see an unearned credential on a number. The failure mode of the outcome actually delivered is narrower: a reader of the methodology document could mistake UNKNOWABLE for a clean bill of health, which the Validation status section blocks by stating in its own words that the score has never been compared against anything that happened.

functions.name: scan_document
functions.input: A pathlib Path to one PDF in the reference corpus, opened twice — once with fitz for full text and once with pdfplumber for table structure.
functions.output: A DocumentScan carrying page count, extracted text length, SA3/SA4 token counts, the count of pages that carry a raster image but almost no text and were therefore not read, the largest number of label-to-value pairs in any single table, and how many tables clear the ten-pair bar on a page naming an ASGS geography.
functions.if_none: A document whose text is under fifty characters per page has no usable text layer; scan_document returns early WITHOUT recording zero tables, and main reports it as RED UNKNOWABLE rather than as a document containing no reference. A corrupt PDF raises from fitz.open and aborts the sweep loudly.

functions.name: count_label_value_pairs
functions.input: One extracted table as a list of rows of cells, from pdfplumber extract_tables.
functions.output: The count of DISTINCT text labels that carry at least one parseable number in the same row — distinct because a repeated label is one region reported twice, not two regions.
functions.if_none: A table of prose, or one whose only digits are footnote markers or years in text cells, yields zero pairs because a value cell must match a full numeric pattern rather than merely contain a digit.

functions.name: main
functions.input: Optional argv whose first element overrides the corpus directory, needed because climate_risk_intel is gitignored and therefore absent from any worktree checkout.
functions.output: Exit code 0 while the recorded REFERENCE ABSENT verdict holds, and 1 both when a usable reference appears and when the corpus is missing or empty. Prints a per-document table and a stated verdict either way.
functions.if_none: A missing or empty corpus directory prints RED with the reason and exits 1, labelled UNKNOWABLE rather than a pass, so a sweep over zero documents can never be mistaken for a sweep that found nothing.

values.value: Pass mark rho > 0.7 STRICT, pre-committed 2026-05-15 in docs/CLIMATE_RISK_METHODOLOGY.md before any run, reproduced exactly as written and not renegotiated. An earlier draft of this job's validation table restated it as rho >= 0.7 while describing it as pre-committed; Sol caught the change and it was reverted. Loosening a strict inequality is a silent renegotiation of the exact kind the pass mark exists to prevent, and a result of exactly 0.700 is not a pass.
values.if_missing: If the pass mark had not been written down in advance, any result could have been argued into a pass after the fact, which is the failure this campaign exists to remove.

values.value: 0 of 22 reference documents carry a rankable label-to-value table; 1303 pages swept; the largest label-to-value table anywhere holds 7 pairs against a floor of 10; APRA Mind the Gap 2026 is the ONLY document mentioning an ASGS unit (SA3 twice, SA4 twice); 374 of 1303 pages carry a content-sized image nothing in the sweep can read, 7 of them in APRA Mind the Gap — pages 16 and 17, at 20.7% and 38.4% image coverage, ARE Figures 9 and 10, the SA3 protection-gap results. The verdict is therefore REFERENCE NOT EXTRACTABLE, not REFERENCE ABSENT.
values.read_at: python scripts/measure_climate_reference_availability.py climate_risk_intel, run 2026-08-07 after the recursion and image-coverage fixes
values.if_missing: Without the sweep the claim that no SA3 series exists would be an unsupported negative about 17 documents, which is exactly the class of claim the prior-art rule forbids asserting without its commands.

values.value: 0 stored climate reports. property_reports holds shadow 538, flood 151, solar-yield 63, bushfire 60 and no climate product; 0 rows carry a composite band or interaction_bonus; 0 report_audit_trail rows mention climate or NARCliM.
values.if_missing: If stored climate rows existed, D3's blast radius would be non-zero and a data repair would need measuring and authorising. Measured at zero, so there is nothing to repair and no production write is proposed.

queries.purpose: Establish whether any stored report carries a climate composite, to size D3's blast radius on stored data.
queries.file_line: ad-hoc read-only measurement, 2026-08-07; connection pinned with conn.set_session(readonly=True, autocommit=True)
queries.where_clause: GROUP BY product for the census; then WHERE outputs::text ILIKE '%"band"%' OR outputs::text ILIKE '%interaction_bonus%' GROUP BY product. Both scoped to property_reports. Result: zero rows on the second query.

queries.purpose: Check whether the audit trail records climate or NARCliM as a queried source, following the #878 lesson that historic audit rows must be found before any claim about what was served.
queries.where_clause: WHERE data_sources_queried::text ILIKE '%climate%' OR data_sources_queried::text ILIKE '%NARCliM%' on report_audit_trail. Result: 0.

queries.purpose: Measure the real geographic extent of the hazard overlays the score reads, because the code's own confidence_reason strings describe the ingest as geographically partial and that shapes what any future comparison could mean.
queries.where_clause: WHERE layer_type = ANY(%s) over the nine hazard layers, GROUP BY layer_type, aggregating ST_YMin/ST_YMax/ST_XMin/ST_XMax. Result: bushfire 225688 rows spanning lat -37.51 to -28.16 and lng 141.00 to 153.64, flood 42572, fire_history 37588, landslide 17483, coastal layers 331 to 5700. A bounding box spanning NSW is not proof of per-LGA completeness and is not read as one.

break_it.scenario: The correlation is computed anyway by aggregating point scores to SA3 using a sampling scheme chosen after seeing the result, and reported as a pass.
break_it.what_happens: The composite is dominated by binary flood and bushfire flags, so an SA3 aggregate is close to 'fraction of sampled points inside a hazard polygon'. That moves substantially depending on whether sampling is by area, population, or address — a free parameter large enough to steer rho toward any target. A tuned pass would license the word 'validated' on a score that had been compared to nothing.
break_it.how: No correlation was computed. The job stopped at the validate-the-test step, as the brief instructs when a check cannot falsify, and the sampling degree of freedom is recorded in the Validation status section as reason 2 of why the comparison would not validate the score even with the missing data.

E

mutation_analysis: The script's core claim is that no candidate reference exists. A stub returning zero candidates unconditionally produces identical REFERENCE ABSENT output, so the negative result alone is worth nothing — which is why four planted cases were run rather than reasoned about. Against a twelve-row SA3 annex an always-zero implementation still prints ABSENT while the real one prints AVAILABLE and exits 1, so the two are distinguishable. Each guard was mutation-checked by construction: dropping the geography-context requirement would let any ten-row numeric table pass; loosening VALUE_CELL from a full-match to a digit search would let the decoy's footnote year count as a value; moving the pair count back to document scope would let the decoy pass; and removing the text-layer floor would turn the scanned case from RED into a silent ABSENT. Existing suite: 3849 passed, 20 skipped (18 for missing shapely/matplotlib imports, pre-existing and tracked as job 1c), no regressions.
residual_risk: The composite score is still computed on every /pipeline/climate-risk call and still returned in the API JSON as outputs.score and outputs.band, unvalidated. No customer-facing renderer reads it. Recommendation, not actioned: drop score and band from the API response, or leave them and accept that an unvalidated composite is reachable by anyone who calls the endpoint directly. Separately, three version strings disagree — the changelog documents v1.2, methodology_version is '1.1', and the served disclaimer text opens 'Climate Risk Awareness Score v1.0'. The card renders both 'v1.1' and the 'v1.0' disclaimer on the same screen. Reported, not fixed: it is a served-output change outside this job's boundary. Sol raised four findings on this diff and all four were confirmed on the evidence and fixed; none was overridden. The most serious was not in the script: the validation table restated the pre-committed pass mark as rho >= 0.7 when the 2026-05-15 document says rho > 0.7 strict, while describing it as pre-committed.
